name: atomic-atlas
description: Educational simulator of the effects of nuclear weapons, missiles and nuclear accidents on a real map and globe.

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.dist:linux: npm run check && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/dist-win.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run check && npm run android:sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs
